Container.Name: UnKeep
Container.Overview:
UnKeep is a private, self-hosted, Google Keep-style notes app (an installable PWA) with end-to-end encrypted sync. Notes are encrypted on your devices; this container is a small relay that only stores ciphertext. It also works as a scratchpad that AI agents can read and write from the terminal with the bundled unkeep CLI.
HTTPS IS REQUIRED. Browsers block the encryption UnKeep uses on plain-HTTP addresses, so the WebUI link (http://server-ip:port) shows an "UnKeep needs HTTPS" page. Publish it through Tailscale Serve, a reverse proxy such as Nginx Proxy Manager or SWAG, or Cloudflare Tunnel, and open that HTTPS address.
Before first start: create the appdata folder owned by nobody:users, for example: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/unkeep && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/unkeep. Generate two different random tokens (for example with: openssl rand -hex 32) for the setup and recovery tokens.
On the first device, enter the setup token and save the recovery kit it offers. Pair later devices from an unlocked one. Back up the appdata folder before updates: 0.x releases may change the database in one direction only.
Container.Requires: An HTTPS front end (Tailscale Serve, a reverse proxy, or Cloudflare Tunnel). UnKeep does not work over plain HTTP on the LAN.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Relay and web app port (plain HTTP). Put HTTPS in front of it; do not expose it directly to the internet.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Encrypted vault database. Must be owned by 99:100 (nobody:users). Back it up before updating.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: One-time secret for creating the vault on the first device. 32-256 printable characters, no spaces (for example: openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: Recovery token
Config.Description: Operator secret for restoring access with a recovery kit after losing every device. 32-256 characters and different from the setup token. Keep it somewhere safe.

Config.Name: Link previews
Config.Description: Set to 1 for Keep-style link previews. The relay then fetches previewed URLs, so it sees them in plain text and needs outbound internet access.

Config.Name: Allowed origin
Config.Description: Optional exact HTTPS origin (for example https://notes.example.com) allowed to call the relay cross-origin. Leave empty when the web app and relay share one address.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set to 1 only if your reverse proxy replaces (not appends to) X-Forwarded-For, so rate limits see real client addresses.

Config.Name: Max attachment size
Config.Description: Maximum attachment size in bytes. Default 26214400 (25 MiB), maximum 104857600 (100 MiB).
